scope.summary: Implement the build-rule gate that fails the build if any shipped Studio command lacks a complete typed contract: stable command_id (studio.<domain>.<command>.vN), inputSchema/outputSchema (schemars-generated), dry_run availability, a SimulationReceipt-class receipt with stable finding codes + JSON-Pointer suggested_fix, undo semantics, and a declared Argus target for any operator-visible surface it affects. Commands without a typed contract MUST NOT ship. Also enforces STU-MDL-005: no capability reachable from one projection but not the other (except intentional operator-only/headless with a typed reason).
acceptance_criteria: build fails on incomplete command contract; projection parity enforced with typed-reason exemptions
expected_tests: test: build-gate fails on a command missing any contract element
test: projection-parity check flags a capability reachable from only one projection (unless typed-reason exempt)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Model API / Command-contract completeness (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Under-specified commands ship; model self-correction loop + projection parity break.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
